title: check refuses a trivial check only on open items, but the live-backlog test it mirrors reads done items too, so a done item turns main red
goal: backlog.py check and test_done_flags_noop_check_real_backlog_commands agree on which items they read: check also errors on a done item whose check trivial_command flags (or the test reads open items only), so an item done with a trivial check is refused at its own push instead of turning main red for later landings; a test plants a done item with check python3 -c pass and check exits 1. Found by the SP-42bn4vz7 review of ST-gpodng3o.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_base,bl_check;bl=bl_base.Backlog('.');bl.items['TK-zzzzzzzz']=dict(id='TK-zzzzzzzz',kind='task',title='Planted',status='done',checks=[dict(run=['python3','-c','pass'])]);sys.exit(0 if any('TK-zzzzzzzz' in x for x in bl_check.refused_command_errors(bl)) else 1)
